title: Sealed retail unit, seven panels
standfirst: The strongest reading this tool produces on a sealed box — and it still stops short of certain.

evidence_ledger.detail: Extracted model A3047 matches Pro 2 USB-C part.
evidence_ledger.source: Apple, 'Identify your AirPods' (support.apple.com)

evidence_ledger.detail: Paper pull-tab seals with green arrows are present and the box is not wrapped, matching Apple's retail packaging for this generation.
evidence_ledger.source: r/AreMyAirpodsAuthentic community guide, Step 1 (ruled authoritative by owner)

evidence_ledger.detail: Copyright year 2024 is consistent with Pro 2 USB-C (minimum 2023).
evidence_ledger.source: Apple 'Identify your AirPods' (introduction years); owner (2025 ceiling)

evidence_ledger.detail: Serial DKM4••••PT is well-formed (10 uppercase alphanumeric characters). Format only -- this check cannot detect a cloned serial copied from a genuine unit, so confirm it separately at checkcoverage.apple.com.
evidence_ledger.source: Observed on 4 genuine units, 7 corpus listings and 2 counterfeits: 10 characters throughout, except AirPods Pro 1 at 12. Well-formedness only - both counterfeits used 10 characters too, so length does not discriminate

evidence_ledger.detail: Only 1 of the four serials was legible, so they cannot be cross-checked. Apple prints one on the box label, one under the case lid and one on each earbud stem. Photograph: case lid, left earbud, right earbud.
evidence_ledger.source: r/AreMyAirpodsAuthentic community guide, Step 2 (four serial locations); Apple 'Identify your AirPods' (serial is on the underside of the case lid)

evidence_ledger.detail: The box label prints '(S) Serial' with the expected space after the (S) marker ('(S) Serial No. DKM4••••PT').
evidence_ledger.source: Project owner (domain expert); corroborated by community-guide label photographs

evidence_ledger.detail: The label's letterforms were not measured. This check needs a close, straight-on photograph of the printed label block.
evidence_ledger.source: Measured against San Francisco (Apple's packaging typeface, shipped with macOS). NOT CALIBRATED - reported as an observation, never as a finding

evidence_ledger.detail: No misspelled text was found in the printed packaging copy.
evidence_ledger.source: Community guide (printed misspellings); corpus measurement (kerning excluded)

evidence_ledger.detail: Images show: the box rear panel, a box side, the box underside label, the box front, the case exterior, an earbud, accessories. Not photographed: the underside of the case lid (serial).
evidence_ledger.source: Observation only - no factual claim made

next_steps: Open the case and photograph the underside of the lid - the serial is printed there, and it should match the serial on the box. (resolves: Serial Cross-Match)

title: Counterfeit caught on the label
standfirst: A listing whose serial passes Apple's own coverage lookup. Its punctuation does not.

evidence_ledger.detail: Extracted model A2698 matches Pro 2 Lightning part.
evidence_ledger.source: Apple, 'Identify your AirPods' (support.apple.com)

evidence_ledger.detail: Neither plastic wrap nor paper pull-tabs are visible, which is expected for an already-opened box. Seal type could not be assessed from these images.
evidence_ledger.source: r/AreMyAirpodsAuthentic community guide, Step 1 (ruled authoritative by owner)

evidence_ledger.detail: No copyright year was legible. It is printed in the fine print block on the underside of the box.
evidence_ledger.source: Apple 'Identify your AirPods' (introduction years); owner (2025 ceiling)

evidence_ledger.detail: Serial KY26••••6F is well-formed (10 uppercase alphanumeric characters). Format only -- this check cannot detect a cloned serial copied from a genuine unit, so confirm it separately at checkcoverage.apple.com.

evidence_ledger.detail: Only 1 of the four serials was legible, so they cannot be cross-checked. Apple prints one on the box label, one under the case lid and one on each earbud stem. Photograph: case lid, left earbud, right earbud.

evidence_ledger.detail: The box label prints '(S)Serial' with no space after the (S) marker ('(S)Serial No. KY26••••6F'). Genuine Apple labels place a space there. This is one of the most reliable single tells on the printed label.
evidence_ledger.source: Project owner (domain expert); corroborated by community-guide label photographs

evidence_ledger.detail: The label's letterforms were not measured. This check needs a close, straight-on photograph of the printed label block.
evidence_ledger.source: Measured against San Francisco (Apple's packaging typeface, shipped with macOS). NOT CALIBRATED - reported as an observation, never as a finding

evidence_ledger.detail: No misspelled text was found in the printed packaging copy.

evidence_ledger.detail: Images show: the box front, the box underside label, the case exterior. Not photographed: the underside of the case lid (serial).
evidence_ledger.source: Observation only - no factual claim made

next_steps: Open the case and photograph the underside of the lid - the serial is printed there, and it should match the serial on the box. (resolves: Serial Cross-Match)
